edits.new:
class WorkflowResult:
    prepared: list[PreparedFile]
    checkpoint: Path | None
    preflight: list[CheckResult]
    build: list[CheckResult]
    verify: list[CheckResult]
    tests: list[CheckResult]
    applied: bool
    rolled_back: bool

build_results: list[CheckResult] = []
    verify_results: list[CheckResult] = []
    test_results: list[CheckResult] = []

    try:
        build_results = run_build(
            repo,
            spec,
        )

        verify_results = run_verification(
            repo,
            spec,
        )

        test_results = run_tests(
            repo,
            spec,
        )

    except Exception as exc:
        if get_rollback_on_verify_failure(
            spec
        ):
            restore_checkpoint(
                repo,
                checkpoint,
            )

            raise PatchForgeError(
                "Post-apply build/verification/test phase failed. "
                "Patch Forge automatically rolled "
                f"back checkpoint {checkpoint.name}.\n"
                f"Original error: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        raise

    return WorkflowResult(
        prepared=prepared,
        checkpoint=checkpoint,
        preflight=preflight,
        build=build_results,
        verify=verify_results,
        tests=test_results,
        applied=True,
        rolled_back=False,
    )
